svg.title: Seven ways to give an agent the same metric
svg.desc: Results table, stage 1, the same 24 questions. Columns: Technique, Right figure, basis named (of 24), Score of record (of 24), AI Credits per turn (median), Refuses with a code. Rows: Generated tools, raw tables: 22, 21, 0.020 credits, refuses with a code; Generated tools, gap-filled view: 24, 24, 0.020 credits, refuses with a code; Generated semantic view: 19, 15, 0.104 credits, refuses in prose; Skill, script computes: 20, 17, 0.097 credits, refuses in prose; Skill, agent writes queries: 19, 15, 0.081 credits, refuses in prose; Autopilot semantic view: 19, 16, 0.069 credits, refuses in prose; Hand-written semantic view: 19, 13, 0.055 credits, refuses in prose. The two with generated tools are highlighted. * replayed the same questions after the campaign. One run per question: counts, not rates. Score of record: right figure, basis named, and no unit on the coverage (rubric 3.2). Credits: the agent's, billed; the warehouse is billed apart.

The same 24 questions, the same model
